title: HeartLegacy® Announces Partnership with Spectrum Retirement Communities, LLC
markdown:
[Accessibility Statement](https://www.cision.com/about/accessibility/) [Skip Navigation](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/heartlegacy-announces-partnership-with-spectrum-retirement-communities-llc-300521127.html#main)

DAPHNE, Ala., Sept. 18, 2017 /PRNewswire/ -- [HeartLegacy](https://heartlegacy.com/), LLC, a Daphne, AL-based technology company, today announced its partnership with Spectrum Retirement Communities, LLC.

Supporting fifty-one senior communities in twelve states, Spectrum will use HeartLegacy's technology to connect senior residents and families through video; capture residents' life story videos through HeartLegacy's [Life Story Program](https://heartlegacy.com/life-stories/) ™; and generate awareness of its communities through marketing videos.

[![HeartLegacy Partners With Spectrum Retirement Communities](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/556785/HeartLegacy_Spectrum_Retirement.mp4?p=medium)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/heartlegacy-announces-partnership-with-spectrum-retirement-communities-llc-300521127.html#)

HeartLegacy Partners With Spectrum Retirement Communities

Using HeartLegacy, [Spectrum](http://www.spectrumretirement.com/) will address several business objectives, including:

- resident engagement
- family communications
- resident legacy preservation
- lead generation
- digital marketing

J.R. Comita, Spectrum's Vice President of Life Enrichment, says:

"HeartLegacy is perfect for resident engagement and online marketing. Families love seeing HeartLegacy videos of their loved ones. Even better, HeartLegacy showcases how much fun we have in our beautiful communities. Online video is essential in today's world. HeartLegacy makes it easy and effective."

Spectrum properties include independent living, assisted living, and memory care communities. Deployment of HeartLegacy will match the needs and personality of each community.

Walt Armentrout, HeartLegacy CEO and Co-Founder, remarks:

"Our partnership with Spectrum Retirement provides an opportunity for families and residents to connect and engage like never before. We're excited about taking the next step with Spectrum in providing a higher quality of life for all those in the continuum of care. As our two organizations continue to grow alongside one another, we will both be working towards one common goal: making their communities feel like home."

HeartLegacy currently serves senior living communities and home care agencies throughout North America with its video kiosk, Remy®, and smartphone application, RemyGo™. Founded in 2014, HeartLegacy upholds a mission of connecting families and preserving family legacies.

**About HeartLegacy** HeartLegacy is a technology company located in Daphne, AL. Designed for senior living communities and home care agencies, HeartLegacy's solution connects seniors and families through video. Learn more at heartlegacy.com.

**About Spectrum** Headquartered in Denver, CO, Spectrum Retirement Communities, LLC is a leading developer, owner, and operator of retirement, assisted living, and memory care communities across the United States. Spectrum's mission is to empower seniors to continue along on their paths to personal growth, health, and wellness. Learn more at spectrumretirement.com.
